# The Marram Coast Record

Independent daily coverage of the Marram estuary: the harbour, the ferry, the
tidal scheme, and the people arguing about all three. Reader comments are open on
every story and are moderated before they appear.

## Sections

- [News archive](https://example.com/news): every story, newest first.
- [Harbour dredging pushed back to autumn](https://example.com/news/harbour-dredging-delayed)
- [Ferry winter timetable consultation](https://example.com/news/ferry-timetable-consultation)
- [Tidal Reach at the Harbour Lights, reviewed](https://example.com/news/tidal-scheme-review)

## Staff

- [Mara Quill](https://example.com/authors/mara-quill), reporter and critic.
